message.content:
Treated as a functional unit under Note 4 to Section XVI, the system takes the mixer's heading. That gives heading 8479, machines having individual functions. Subheading 8479.82 covers mixing, kneading, crushing, grinding, screening, sifting, homogenizing, emulsifying or stirring machines. Within it, 8479.82.0040 is the "other" mixing line, as opposed to the line for blending/kneading machines for rubber. CBP rulings on similar sealant mixing systems have classified them under 8479.82.0040.

{"hts_code": "8479.82.0040", "reason": "The interconnected components together perform one clearly defined function, mixing, so the system is a functional unit under Note 4 to Section XVI and falls under 8479.82 as a mixing machine with individual functions."}
